Read me first: 1. Sheet 'Responses': row 1 = ID, Q1, Q2, Q3 …  then ONE ROW PER STUDENT. Column A = anonymous ID (no names).
2. Put the correct answers in ONE ROW labelled Key in column A (here: row 2). It can be at the top or the bottom. Delete it if your key is elsewhere.
3. Answers can be letters (A, B, C, D), numbers (1 to 4), or the option text itself. Use the same style in the Key row. Leave a cell empty if unanswered.
4. Other ways to give the key: a separate sheet named Answer_Key (Question, Answer), a separate file uploaded in step 2, or choose it on the page.
5. Delete the example students, paste your own, save as .xlsx, and upload.
The example data in this file is made up, so you can try the app straight away.
